# The IL assembler.  corlib needs it before anything else can be built, which
# is why it is in the bootstrap profile at all.
#
# Its parser is generated by jay.  The makefiles wrote ILParser.cs next to the
# sources.  It goes to the build tree here instead.  That works because a
# generated source is passed to csc on the command line rather than named in
# a .sources file.
mono_jay_parser(
  TARGET  ilasm-parser
  OUTPUT  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ILParser.cs"
  GRAMMAR parser/ILParser.jay
  FLAGS   -ct)

mono_declare_managed(
  PROGRAM
  NAME       ilasm.exe
  PROFILES   build
  REFS       PEAPI System
  BUILT_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ILParser.cs"
  DEPENDS    ilasm-parser
  TARGET_NET_REFERENCE v4.7
  INTERMEDIATE)

# The shipped one, which can sign what it assembles.
mono_declare_managed(
  PROGRAM
  NAME       ilasm.exe
  PROFILES   net_4_x
  REFS       PEAPI System Mono.Security
  FLAGS      -d:HAS_MONO_SECURITY
  BUILT_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ILParser.cs"
  DEPENDS    ilasm-parser)
